title: Recurrency, not frontal workspace activation, makes a state conscious

statements.text: Fully unconscious feedforward activity can already activate prefrontal workspace neurons, so the feature that separates conscious from unconscious states is recurrence, not the activation of the frontal workspace.

sources.quote: also in fully unconscious feedforward activation (I1), there is activation of workspace neurons
seems to be the recurrency, not the activation of workspace (frontal) neurons
